instruction:
Warehouse Upgrade Retrofit IFC And Revit Sheet PDF

This task starts from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc and uses the local reference image C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_sheet.png. In Revit, modify the starting model into a warehouse upgrade scheme, export the model as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, and export a one-page Revit sheet PDF as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf in the Desktop.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf; C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc is at least 500 bytes and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf is at least 200 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities, 2 IfcSpace entities, 8 IfcWall entities, and 2 IfcSlab entities.
5. The IFC model contains 0 IfcRoof, 0 IfcDoor, 0 IfcWindow, 0 IfcStair, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, 0 IfcCurtainWall, and 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy entities.
6. After replacing hyphens and underscores with spaces and lowercasing names, the IfcSpace name list contains the token warehouse at least once and area at least once.
7. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf contains exactly 1 page exported from a Revit sheet.
8. The extracted text from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf contains the case-insensitive tokens WAREHOUSE UPGRADE and Principal upgrade sheet.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
